 2 minute read BLACKPINK’s Lisa’s New Song Thanks Former Lover for Letting Her Go 
 Eungee Joh November 19, 2026 
 Credit: LLOUD 
 BLACKPINK’s Lisa released a new song about heartbreak and moving on, offering a glimpse into her personal experiences with relationships.
 Billboard featured Lisa’s new single “Leave With Me” on November 18th, describing it as a song about thanking a former lover for letting her go and finding her true place in life.
 The song serves as the closing track for Always Lalisa , a documentary that follows Lisa’s solo career over the course of about a year. The film premiered exclusively on YouTube Premium on the same day.
 In the documentary, Lisa opened up about the pressure to keep her romantic relationships private as a K-pop star.
 “You can’t date in K-pop culture,” she said. “If you’re seeing someone and get caught by paparazzi, your popularity drops.”
 She continued, “I dated a few times when I was younger, but I had to keep those relationships hidden. I didn’t want my dating life to affect BLACKPINK’s popularity.”
 Lisa also revealed that “Dream,” a track from her debut full-length album Alter Ego , released last year, was inspired by a secret relationship from her past. She even asked the person involved for permission before releasing the song.
 “Leave With Me” was first heard as the documentary’s closing track when the film screened in theaters in October. Lisa later performed the song live for the first time during the opening week of her Las Vegas residency, VIVA LA LISA , which kicked off on November 12th.
 Lisa has also been linked to Frédéric Arnault, a member of the family behind French luxury group LVMH. However, neither has publicly confirmed a relationship. Vanity Fair reported in June that the two appeared to have gone their separate ways .
